newsitem.title: USA: Intl Game Technology wins court ruling.
newsitem.headline: Intl Game Technology wins court ruling.

text.p: International Game Technology said on Thursday a federal court has prohibited WMS Industries Inc from making, using or selling its Model 401 slot machines while a patent infringement case between the companies is pending.
The preliminary injunction, granted in U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, comes one week after the court issued a temporary restraining order against WMS.
International Game claims the Model 401, a spinning reel slot machine, violates a patent centering on the ability of a machine to expand a games odds using computer software.
In its statement, International Game said WMS has indicated it will appeal this ruling.

International Game said in a related case centered on WMS's Model 400 slot machine that was argued before the same court, IGT earlier obtained a permanent injunction prohibiting WMS from manufacturing, using or selling the machine.
WMS has appealed the lower court's ruling to the Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit. WMS filed a motion for a stay of the lower court's injunction while the appeal is pending.
The Federal Circuit granted an emergency stay until it decides WMS' motion.
